mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_user_settings ( user_id, embedding_base_url, embedding_api_key_cipher, embedding_model, embedding_dim, embedding_path, rerank_enabled, rerank_base_url, rerank_api_key_cipher, rerank_model, rerank_path, updated_at) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{embeddingBaseUrl}, #{embeddingApiKeyCipher}, #{embeddingModel}, #{embeddingDim}, #{embeddingPath}, #{rerankEnabled}, #{rerankBaseUrl}, #{rerankApiKeyCipher}, #{rerankModel}, #{rerankPath}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE embedding_base_url = new.embedding_base_url, embedding_api_key_cipher = new.embedding_api_key_cipher, embedding_model = new.embedding_model, embedding_dim = new.embedding_dim, embedding_path = new.embedding_path, rerank_enabled = new.rerank_enabled, rerank_base_url = new.rerank_base_url, rerank_api_key_cipher = new.rerank_api_key_cipher, rerank_model = new.rerank_model, rerank_path = new.rerank_path, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

INSERT INTO kb_user_settings ( user_id, rerank_enabled, rerank_base_url, rerank_api_key_cipher, rerank_model, rerank_path, updated_at) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{rerankEnabled}, #{rerankBaseUrl}, #{rerankApiKeyCipher}, #{rerankModel}, #{rerankPath}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rerank_enabled = new.rerank_enabled, rerank_base_url = new.rerank_base_url, rerank_api_key_cipher = new.rerank_api_key_cipher, rerank_model = new.rerank_model, rerank_path = new.rerank_path, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

INSERT INTO kb_user_settings (user_id, rerank_enabled, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{enabled}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rerank_enabled = new.rerank_enabled, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_user_settings SET embedding_base_url = NULL, embedding_api_key_cipher = NULL, embedding_model = NULL, embedding_dim = NULL, embedding_path = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE kb_user_settings SET rerank_enabled = TRUE, rerank_base_url = NULL, rerank_api_key_cipher = NULL, rerank_model = NULL, rerank_path = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE user_id = #{userId}
